item.title: Selection As Heisman Finalist “Surreal” for Julian Sayin, Even if Big Ten Championship Game Disappointment Lingers
item.description: The realization of a lifelong dream feels sweeter than words can express, even if it comes after bitter disappointment. item.title: Michigan Fires Head Coach Sherrone Moore for Inappropriate Relationship with Staff Member
item.description: Sherrone Moore is out after two seasons as Michigan’s head coach. Michigan fired Sherrone Moore for cause on Wednesday after a university investigation found that Moore had engaged in an inappropriate relationship with a staff member, according to a statement by Michigan athletic director Warde Manuel. item.title: Former Michigan Coach Sherrone Moore In Jail, Under Investigation for Alleged Assault Hours After Firing from Michigan
item.description: Sherrone Moore is under investigation for an alleged assault that occurred on the same afternoon he was fired by Michigan. The Pittsfield Township Police Department confirmed Wednesday night in a media release that it is investigating an alleged assault by Moore and that the now-former Michigan coach was in custody at the Washtenaw County Jail pending review of charges by the Washtenaw County Prosecutor.
